headline: Agenda covers reviewing exemption and Chapter Land applications, and abatement applications in executive session.
summary: The agenda lists approval of the minutes and executive minutes from August 11, 2026. Items also include reviewing exemption and Chapter Land applications as they are submitted, and an executive session on abatement and exemption applications, where votes may be taken.
plain_text:
COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS
          Town of Sutton
               Pursuant to GL Chapter 30A, §§ 18-25 you are hereby
                notified of a meeting which includes the following agenda
Board/Committee:   Board of Assessors
Date/Time:  August 18, 2026 - 5:00 PM
Town Hall, Assessor’s Office – In Person
1. Open meeting and review Agenda
2. Approve Minutes of August 11, 2026
3. Approve Executive Minutes of August 11, 2026
4. The Board will review Exemption Applications as 
they are submitted
5. The Board will review Chapter Land Applications 
as they are submitted
6. Board members will each work on individual 
projects as needed weekly
7. Sign documents
8. Other Business Not Anticipated
9. Meet in Executive Session to review abatement 
and/or exemption applications
Pursuant to G.L. c.30A, §21(a)(7) (“Purpose 7”), the
Board will meet in executive session to discuss, 
comply with, and/or act under the authority of G.L. 
c.59, §60; votes may be taken
10. Adjourn meeting from the executive session – the 
Board will not reconvene in an open session
transcript:
# COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS

## Town of Sutton

Pursuant to GL Chapter 30A, §§ 18-25 you are hereby notified of a meeting which includes the following agenda

Board/Committee: Board of Assessors
Date/Time: August 18, 2026 - 5:00 PM
Town Hall, Assessor’s Office – In Person

1. Open meeting and review Agenda
2. Approve Minutes of August 11, 2026
3. Approve Executive Minutes of August 11, 2026
4. The Board will review Exemption Applications as they are submitted
5. The Board will review Chapter Land Applications as they are submitted
6. Board members will each work on individual projects as needed weekly
7. Sign documents
8. Other Business Not Anticipated
9. Meet in Executive Session to review abatement and/or exemption applications

Pursuant to G.L. c.30A, §21(a)(7) (“Purpose 7”), the Board will meet in executive session to discuss, comply with, and/or act under the authority of G.L. c.59, §60; votes may be taken

10. Adjourn meeting from the executive session – the Board will not reconvene in an open session
